category: IP geolocation API and database download

free_tier.stated: 1,000 requests a day with a free account and key, full response, no payment details, not a trial; 30 lookups a day per client IP without a key (ownership and location fields only); a free geolocation database in CSV for IPv4 and IPv6
free_tier.notes: one-time credits beyond the free tier cost USD 1 per 30,000 requests and never expire

per_object_cap.stated: the free IPv4 geolocation database zip is 65,954,248 bytes

retention.stated: storage of API results is not stated

interface_detail: GET api.ipapi.is/?q=IP&key=KEY, or POST a JSON body with q and key; without a key the answer carries 11 keys and a docs link, and bulk and ASN queries answer 403 ERR_FORBIDDEN_API_KEY_REQUIRED; free files at ipapi.is/data/geolocationDatabaseIPv4.csv.zip and geolocationDatabaseIPv6.csv.zip with no account
tooling: any HTTP client; any CSV tool for the database
chaining: 1,000 keyed lookups a day with VPN, proxy, datacenter and abuse fields, plus a free WHOIS-sourced geolocation file for local lookups; one-time credits at USD 1 per 30,000 requests extend it without a subscription. Bulk path: the free CSV database download; bulk API queries need a key

limits.value: 1,000 requests a day with a free key; 30 a day per client IP without a key

identity_cost.detail: a free account with email and password and a short how-did-you-hear field, or GitHub or Google sign-in; no payment details

reliability_note: keyless callers get HTTP 429 after 30 lookups a day and a 24-hour firewall block if they keep sending; the free database has fewer entries and reduced accuracy
confidence_note: the free-tier, pricing, geolocation-database and signup pages were quoted on 2026-10-30; a keyless lookup answered HTTP 200 with the short response and a ranged read of the free IPv4 zip answered HTTP 206 with no account.
